version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

debugEnabled.description: To debug or not to debug

setupOK.description: Set to false if we timeout in waitFor...

originalLocale.description: The original locale in this context

removeLimit.description: Max number of entities you can remove with external filter

failOnQueueErrors.description: Fail a test if a queue error is detected

waitForTeardown.description: Call waitForSetup on teardown for _waitForTeardown seconds

queueBlacklist.description: Don't check these queues in waitForSetup

tryToRecover.description: A number of attempts to recover

fsFiles.description: FileSystem (e.g. S3 or Azure) file names

mocks.description: ActionMocks that have been registered with this context.

testUsers.description: An array of TestApiObj ids for {@link User}s created using this test context

uuidCounter.description: Counter for creating unique ids or names for test objects

title:
Main container for TestApi. Contains all of the information and functionality necessary for
TestApi to operate properly. The majority of tests will not need to use TestApiContext methods
directly.
name: TestApiContext
